bug_semantics: Argument injection (CWE-88) in Commit.count(): **kwargs are forwarded to git rev-list without the check_unsafe_options guard used by sibling iter_items. A caller-controlled options dict can pass output=<path>, producing git rev-list --output=<path> which opens and truncates the target file to 0 bytes (arbitrary file blanking at process privilege). CVE.org CVE-2026-73621 is PUBLISHED; same issue as GHSA-p538-c434-8v24, fixed in 3.1.56.
flaw_origin: 806450db9b2c4a829558557ac90bd7596a0654e0 (repo.commit_delta_base: removed, 2009-10-15) first added **kwargs to Commit.count and forwarded them into repo.git.rev_list(rev, '--', paths, **kwargs). Parent 39229db70e71a6be275dafb3dd9468930e40ae48 had def count(cls, repo, rev, paths='') calling rev_list without kwargs.
ai_marker: absent; human author/committer Sebastian Thiel <byronimo@gmail.com>; no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with/bot on BIC object
evidence: git cat-file -e 39229db70e71a6be275dafb3dd9468930e40ae48:lib/git/objects/commit.py succeeds. Parent count() is def count(cls, repo, rev, paths='') and calls repo.git.rev_list(rev, '--', paths) with no kwargs. BIC first writes def count(cls, repo, rev, paths='', **kwargs) and repo.git.rev_list(rev, '--', paths, **kwargs). git log -1 --format='%an %ae %cn %ce' 806450db => Sebastian Thiel byronimo@gmail.com Sebastian Thiel byronimo@gmail.com; cat-file has no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with. Later 0b3ecf2d / 4114d19e / path moves only reshape the same unguarded kwargs sink. 701ce32f guarded iter_items only. Fix 38553b6fddc7f6a667cdb45a6762343a08fc72b2 adds Git.check_unsafe_options in count(); those lines are absent on parent be5031df. Tag 3.1.56 contains the fix. Advisory published, not withdrawn.
reasoning: The vulnerability is unguarded kwargs-to-rev-list in count(), not the original no-kwargs count() (33ebe7ac) and not later refactors. BIC is the 2009 human commit that first forwarded **kwargs. No AI marker on that commit object. Later AI-marked work (701ce32f, 38553b6f) is incomplete-sibling-guard and the fix, not the introducer. Closed NOT_AI with verified BIC and fix SHA.
